name: Peckham Library
features: Inverted L on thin raking steel legs over a public square; pre-patinated copper skin and coloured glass.
note: Own Commons category with many free exterior photos; also subcategory 'Interior of Peckham Library'.

name: Lord's Media Centre
features: Seamless aluminium semi-monocoque pod built with boatyard methods, lifted on two concrete stair towers.

photos.file: File:Lords Cricket Ground - June 2011 - The Iconic Media Centre (5858018929).jpg
File:J P Morgan Media Centre, Lord's - geograph.org.uk - 3430380.jpg
File:J P Morgan Media Centre at Lord’s Cricket Ground (Ank Kumar) 04.jpg

note: Now called the J.P. Morgan Media Centre. Commons also has an interior subcategory.

name: Stuttgart Music School (Musikhochschule)
by: James Stirling, Michael Wilford and Associates
features: Drum-shaped tower with ring balconies and porthole windows anchors the school next to Stirling's Staatsgalerie.
commons_category: Category:Staatliche Hochschule für Musik und Darstellende Kunst (Stuttgart)

photos.file: File:20230214 Hochschule für Musik und Darstellende Kunst Stuttgart.jpg
File:Staatliche Hochschule fuer Musik und Darstellende Kunst (Stuttgart) 01.jpg
File:Staatliche Hochschule fuer Musik und Darstellende Kunst (Stuttgart) 04 straighten.jpg
File:Staatliche Hochschule fuer Musik und Darstellende Kunst (Stuttgart) 03.jpg

note: Year: the Stirling building opened 1996 (prize 1997); the university's Wikipedia intro says its main building was completed 2002, so check the date before publishing.

name: American Air Museum, Duxford
features: One long low precast-concrete vault, partly sunk into the ground, with a fully glazed end wall.

photos.file: File:Norman Foster's American Air Museum Duxford 2024-07-27.jpg

note: Part of Imperial War Museum Duxford.

name: Laban Dance Centre
features: Gently curved front; a skin of translucent coloured polycarbonate over glass, tinted magenta, turquoise and lime.

photos.file: File:Laban Centre from Deptford Creek - geograph.org.uk - 5109962.jpg

note: Category also holds unrelated Trinity Laban files (portraits, Old Royal Naval College); pick only the Creekside building.

name: Madrid-Barajas Airport Terminal 4
features: Wavy bamboo-lined roof on steel 'trees' painted in a rainbow sequence; light canyons cut through every level.

photos.file: File:Exterior - Aeropuerto de Madrid-Barajas T4 - Madrid 01.jpg
File:Exterior - Aeropuerto de Madrid-Barajas T4 - Madrid 02.jpg

note: Category is huge (mostly interiors, planes). Best exteriors are close-ups of the eave and Y-shaped steel trees (portrait) and one distant night view; a good whole-building exterior wasn't found. Many good interior shots exist.

name: Accordia
by: Feilden Clegg Bradley Studios, Alison Brooks Architects, Maccreanor Lavington
features: Dense brick terraces, mews and courtyards set among mature trees; the first housing scheme to win the Stirling Prize.

photos.file: File:Gardens between Copse Way ^ Henslow Mews - geograph.org.uk - 7636797.jpg

note: Also Category:Accordia, Cambridge (empty when checked). Many small geograph photos; the three listed are large and show the FCB brick terraces.

name: Evelyn Grace Academy
features: Zig-zag glass and steel wings house four small schools; a running track threads under the building to the gate.

photos.file: File:Evelyn Grace Academy, Loughborough Park (1) - geograph.org.uk - 4404993.jpg
File:Evelyn Grace Academy, Loughborough Park (2) - geograph.org.uk - 4404995.jpg

note: Weak: only two 1024x768 geograph photos (grey day, from across the road, building fills the frame width but not much height). They are in neither the category nor >1200px. If the owner wants a stronger image this is a drawing candidate.

name: Magna Science Adventure Centre
features: A vast dark former steelworks shed reused whole, with four pavilions for earth, air, fire and water inside.
note: In the former Templeborough steelworks. Category also has many interior and exhibit shots.

name: Sainsbury Laboratory
features: Low lab round a courtyard in the Botanic Garden; limestone, concrete and timber fins, with a cloister on the garden.

photos.file: File:Cmglee Sainsbury Laboratory Cambridge University night.jpg

note: Also has free interior photos (stairs, lecture theatre).

name: Astley Castle
features: New brick and timber house built inside the fire-gutted ruin; the old walls stay raw, new work sits flush in the gaps.
note: A Landmark Trust holiday let inside a 12th to 16th-century ruin; the award is for the intervention. Good interior photos too (e.g. Astley Castle Cloister.JPG).

name: Newport Street Gallery
features: Listed Victorian workshops joined to new brick end buildings with sawtooth roofs; galleries run through all of them.
note: Damien Hirst's gallery in Vauxhall.

name: Bloomberg London
features: Two sandstone-framed blocks with bronze fins, split by a public arcade; the Roman Temple of Mithras is shown beneath.

photos.file: File:Bloomberg London exterior - Cannon Street, Walbrook.jpg

note: Many free interior photos (ramp, lobby, ceilings) from a Wikimedia UK event; subcategory London Mithraeum.

name: Everyman Theatre
features: Front of metal sunshades cut with life-size portraits of local people; walls of brick reclaimed from the old theatre.
note: Category also holds photos of the pre-2011 theatre (e.g. Everyman Theatre Liverpool.jpg, CC0, shows the old building); use only post-2014 files.

name: Goldsmith Street
features: Passivhaus council homes in tight brick terraces, with a shared planted alley between the back gardens.
note: Most Commons files are 800px geograph photos (meet the 800px rule only just); 6357512 is 2149x3035.

name: New Library, Magdalene College
features: Brick walls and tall chimneys frame timber reading bays lit from pitched glazed roof lanterns.
note: Also File:Magdalene College gardens and library from across the River Cam 2024-03-14.jpg (distant, through trees).

name: Gateshead Millennium Bridge
features: The first tilting bridge: arch and curved deck rotate together like an opening eyelid to let ships pass.

photos.file: File:Gateshead Millennium bridge & BALTIC art gallery, 14 June 2012.jpg

note: Huge category, plus a night subcategory.

name: Stormen Concert Hall and Library
features: Two pale buildings, concert hall and library, frame a new square on the harbour; the library has a tall finned front.
note: Library photos are in the subcategory Category:Stormen bibliotek (includes interiors). Completion year 2014 from memory (concert hall opened 2014); confirm.

name: Arquipélago Contemporary Arts Centre
by: Menos é Mais Arquitectos, João Mendes Ribeiro
features: An 1890s sweet-potato distillery in dark basalt restored and joined by new pale concrete buildings for art.

photos.file: File:Arquipélago - Centro de Artes Contemporâneas, Azoren 2016 01.JPG

note: Weak: only two Commons photos found and no category; the usable one shows the old basalt buildings and chimney, not the new concrete wings (the other is a close-up of the name on a wall). Portugal's freedom of panorama is uncertain. Year 2015 from memory.

name: Toho Gakuen School of Music
features: Soundproof lesson rooms as stacked concrete boxes around a courtyard; gaps between the boxes bring daylight in.

photos.file: File:Toho Gakuen School of Music Chofu Campus.JPG

note: Only one good photo of the Nikken Sekkei building (4608x2339). Other files in the category show other Toho buildings (Senkawa campus). Feature line based on award descriptions from memory; check before publishing.

name: Lille Langebro
features: Cycle and foot bridge of two curved steel spans on slim piers that swing open sideways to let boats through.

name: Hastings Pier
features: Fire-wrecked Victorian pier rebuilt as a wide open deck with a visitor centre, using timber saved from the old pier.
note: Category mixes pre-fire, fire (2010) and post-2016 photos; use only post-2016 ones. 'Hasting Pier Aug 2026' is a high aerial view showing the whole deck.

name: Ring of Remembrance (L'Anneau de la Mémoire)
features: Dark concrete ellipse, part cantilevered over the slope, lined with steel plates naming the WWI dead.

photos.file: File:Notre Dame de Lorette-Anneau de la Mémoire-20151231.jpg

note: France has no freedom of panorama and the architect is alive, so these photos could one day be deleted from Commons; a drawing would be an easy fallback (a flat ellipse on a hill).

name: Central European University
features: Pale Hungarian limestone front with a perforated stone screen; rooflit courtyards knit old and new buildings.
commons_category: Category:New Building of Central European University, Budapest
note: Nádor utca 15. CEU moved most teaching to Vienna in 2019; the building remains.

name: Appleby Blue Almshouse
features: Almshouse flats for older people in brick ranges round a planted courtyard, reached by shared timber-lined galleries.
note: Only one Commons photo (4032x3024, street corner, clear); it sits in Category:Southwark Park Road, London. Completion year 2023 from memory; galleries detail from memory, check.

name: BedZED
features: Low-energy village: south-facing glazed terraces, roof gardens and bright wind cowls that ventilate the homes.

photos.file: File:Housing at BedZED, London Road, Hackbridge (July 2020) (1).jpg
File:Wind Cowls, BedZED, Hackbridge, London Borough of Sutton - Flickr - tonymonblat.jpg

note: Beddington Zero Energy Development, Hackbridge (Sutton), built by Peabody with BioRegional.

name: The New Art Gallery Walsall
features: A tower clad in pale grey terracotta tiles over the canal basin; timber-lined galleries with carefully varied daylight.

photos.file: File:Walsall Art Gallery on a murky day (5529938095).jpg
File:Walsall Art Gallery on a murky day 3 (5530511370).jpg
File:Walsall Art Gallery on a murky day 2 (5529934251).jpg

note: Exterior photos are portrait, on a grey day; the first shows the whole tower.

name: Lewis Glucksman Gallery
features: Timber-clad gallery volumes lifted on slim columns above a limestone plinth, among trees on the university grounds.
note: At University College Cork.

name: Maggie's Centre London
features: A deep orange rendered wall wraps a two-storey pavilion; a wide roof floats above it on a strip of clear glass.
view: front elevation: blank orange wall with an entrance gap, glazed upper storey set back behind it, oversailing flat roof hovering above on slim supports
note: Commons has only three 640px geograph photos (below the 800px rule): Maggie's Centre, Charing Cross, London.jpg; Entrance courtyard...; Roof garden... (CC BY-SA 2.0). The UK has freedom of panorama, so a new free photo is very possible. Drawing is schematic: wall height, number of mullions and support positions are simplified.

name: Weald and Downland Gridshell
features: A three-domed lattice of thin green oak laths bent into a peanut-shell shape over an archive sunk into the chalk slope.
view: long side elevation: three-humped shell profile with two clerestory strips two thirds up and cedar-boarding tier line, on the low archive base
note: Free exterior photos on Commons are all 640px geograph files (e.g. Downland Gridshell - geograph.org.uk - 291120.jpg, Gridshell.jpg); larger free files are interiors (Inside the Gridshell... 7018746, 1600px). Interiors could be extras. Height not sourced, so the profile shows proportion only.

name: Children Village
features: Boarding houses for 540 pupils under one thin roof on a glulam timber grid; rooms of local earth brick and lattice.
view: front elevation of one of the two identical halves: thin flat metal roof on a regular timber column grid, upper floor deck with railing, ground floor of earth-brick walls with lattice bays
note: No photos of it on Commons at all. Sources (via search summaries; the sites themselves were unreachable) confirm the thin white metal roof on a 5.90 m glulam eucalyptus grid, earth-brick rooms and brick lattice, two levels, 540 pupils, 2017. The placement of rooms and lattice bays in the drawing is schematic; worth checking against a photo before publishing.

name: Bishop Edward King Chapel
features: Elliptical chapel walled in patterned stone; inside, a grove of timber columns under a high clerestory.
note: Only one exterior photo, a close view of part of the patterned stone wall (not the whole chapel). Also one interior (Bishop Edward King Chapel (inside)-130928.JPG). Weak; a drawing could help later.

name: The Hepworth Wakefield
features: A cluster of trapezoid blocks in pigmented concrete at the river's edge; each gallery is lit through its sloping roof.

photos.file: File:A view across the River Calder towards the Hepworth, Wakefield, West Yorkshire (31st May 2024) 001.jpg
File:A view across the River Calder towards the Hepworth, Wakefield, West Yorkshire (31st May 2024) 002.jpg
File:Barrier on the Calder, next to Hepworth Gallery - geograph.org.uk - 2743257.jpg

note: Large category; many more exteriors likely, plus artworks.

name: Blavatnik School of Government
features: Stacked glass discs, each shifted off the one below, round a tall central forum open to every floor.

photos.file: File:The Blavatnik School of Government on Walton Street - geograph.org.uk - 6686640.jpg

name: Senedd
features: A rippling cedar roof oversails a glass box on slate steps; a timber funnel lights and ventilates the debating chamber.

photos.file: File:Cardiff - National Assembly for Wales - geograph.org.uk - 6658563.jpg

note: Welsh Parliament building. Subcategories for the timber roof, interior and construction.

name: Burntwood School
features: New teaching blocks and halls in tall sculpted precast-concrete panels, set among the school's 1950s buildings.
note: Commons has ~17 large geograph photos but all I checked were taken during demolition and construction (2013-14); none clearly shows the finished building (3800329 and 3800351 show the new pale block partly, behind rubble). Not drawn: I couldn't establish the massing of the several new blocks with confidence. Year 2014 from memory.

name: Cambridge Central Mosque
features: Glulam timber 'trees' branch into a lattice vault over the prayer hall, behind a garden court and brick walls.
note: Many good interior photos by Cmglee (prayer hall, atrium).

name: Jacoby Studios
features: A 17th-century Capuchin cloister restored as a company HQ, extended with new wings of exposed concrete and timber.
note: No Commons photos found (searched Jacoby, St. Vincenz, Kapuzinerkloster Paderborn). Germany has freedom of panorama, so this is a gap waiting for an upload. Not drawn: sources give two- to three-storey concrete and timber wings around the cloister but not their elevations.

name: Lianzhou Museum of Photography
features: An old warehouse wrapped by a U-shaped new wing under a folded roofscape clad in grey tiles salvaged from local houses.
note: No Commons photos. Not drawn: sources describe a folded roof canopy, a U-shaped new building of three to five levels round the retained warehouse, and grey shingle from demolished houses with local schist, but not the roof geometry precisely enough to draw. Also an RIBA International Award 2021 winner.

name: John Morden Centre, Morden College
features: Day centre for the residents of a 17th-century almshouse, set in its grounds in Blackheath.
note: Commons Category:Morden College has 2022 geograph photos (1024px) but those I checked show the old college buildings, not clearly the new centre; nothing names it. Not drawn: I couldn't find a reachable description of its form. Feature line is deliberately generic; type and concepts are best guesses from what it is, not from a source describing it - check before use.

name: Modulus Matrix: 85 Social Housing in Cornellà
features: 85 social flats in a CLT and glulam frame over a concrete ground floor, on an even grid of rooms round a courtyard.
note: No photos on Commons (Spain has freedom of panorama, so a free photo could be uploaded). Not drawn: search summaries confirm a five-storey timber frame over a concrete ground floor round a courtyard with corner cores, but conflict on whether balconies face the street or the courtyard, and nothing describes the street facade. Completion dates given as 2020, 2021 and 2022 by different sources.

name: British Library
by: Colin St John Wilson, MJ Long
features: Stepped red-brick masses round a raised piazza; inside, the King's Library rises as a tall glass tower.

photos.file: File:Front elevation of the British Library, London - geograph.org.uk - 2277968.jpg
File:London - Euston Road - British Library 1997 by Colin St John Wilson & former Midland Grand Hotel 1868-73 by Sir George Gilbert Scott - View ENE.jpg
